androidTest DeviceVerificationTest still asserts the old em-dash offline label; production moved to the paren wrap '(Offline, cannot reach GS.)' per RULE ZERO. Not in the android-release gate (only testDebugUnitTest runs there); flagged for the next round.

Back gesture with the drawer open exits to the launcher on the API 30 emulator (drawer does not consume BACK there); predictive back on API 33+ likely closes it but this is UNVERIFIED product behavior pending an on-device check on a modern API device.

Three NavHost registrations survived the reduction with zero callers (search/research/vision routes) — unreachable dead destinations, documented in the screen audit; cleanup is design-phase follow-up, not shipped in 82.

OpenRouter keypool remains wiped (platform wipe; operator's keys unrecoverable from disk). Sends serve via the z-ai fallback route (modelRoute=zai/gs-swift) until the operator re-supplies keys; provision via: bun scripts/provision-keys.ts "key1,key2,..."

backend availability depends on the sandbox dev server being alive; a dead server manifests as instant HTML 502 on sends. Per-launch session rotation means the app self-heals its edge routing after any backend restart.
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped. Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
